tool: one-shot local procedure: hashlib.sha256 + os.stat over the cached file, onnx.load + onnx.checker.check_model, EXTERNAL-initializer scan, and a single onnxruntime CPUExecutionProvider inference. Deliberately NOT produced by bench/pinned_bytes.py — a witness generated by the module it is meant to witness would agree with that module by construction. Re-derivable: see the PR body for the exact commands, and bench/test_real_model.py re-checks this digest against the real cached bytes whenever they are present.
why_this_directory: NOT bench/results/rust-model-runner/. That directory holds readings taken by rust/modelrunner against a built onnxruntime_vulkan_ep.dll and is stamped by an artifact frame whose subject is that DLL; this file was not produced by that tool, is about immutable upstream bytes rather than about a build, and cannot go stale when rust/ changes. Filing it there would have been exactly the substitution issue #78 is about - a file with a plausible name standing in for the thing it is named after.

external_data.note: graph carries no EXTERNAL initializers; the .onnx digest covers every weight byte
